subject: Re: Kickoff: arithmetic sampling for diverse decoding
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Farah 60% on the T5X integration, Maren 45% on the eval harness, Saoirse 30% on batching and the parallel decode path.

Budget: Idris has verbally earmarked the full $180k on Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-28 for this project, which covers the decoding sweeps through the end of the window. The decoding sweeps are the cost — every diversity measurement needs many samples per input across several model sizes, and that multiplies fast.

Compute: 64 A100s best-effort on titan-a100. We considered a Vulcan reservation but the sweeps checkpoint cleanly, so preemption is survivable and best-effort is the better use of the budget.

Daniela
